purpose: Plain text page opener for utility-style pages: a small mono label, a large all-caps title and an optional one-sentence lede. Sets the page topic before the main content (plans, demo, post list).

variants.name: with-lede
variants.description: Shared PageHeader component: label, title and lede. Used by pricing and product tour.

variants.name: no-lede
variants.description: Blog copy: the same markup written inline in the page with no lede paragraph. It is a separate duplicate, not the shared component.

label.note: Mono uppercase eyebrow. Semantic inversion: it is the h1.

title.note: Display-3xl heading font, uppercase, balanced. Semantic inversion: it is the h2. Observed 3 to 6 words.

lede.note: Optional; absent in the no-lede variant. Observed 17 words on both pages that use it.

behaviour.note: No background colour and no media.
Heading order is inverted: the small label is the h1 and the large title is the h2.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Static; no animation in either implementation.

changes.change: title column spans 6, 12 (md), 22 (lg), 20 from col 2 (xl); lede column 6, 9 (md), 14 (lg), 12 from col 2 (xl)
